notes: 'config'/'appConfig' mirror the source file's makeConfig()/makeAppConfig() test helpers and their defaults (paperJarPath "server.jar", minRamGB 1, maxRamGB 2, serverDir "/srv/mc"; javaPath "java", extraFlags ""), overridden per-fixture exactly as each Swift test overrides them. The config's own minRamGB/maxRamGB (4/16 GB) are 'sheet-overridden' by explicit resolve params (6/12 GB, matching a UI RAM-slider value in MSC 1's terminology). The resolved jvmFlags must reflect ONLY the sheet values (6144M/12288M) — config RAM (which would produce -Xms4096M, from 4GB) must never leak through.
